stance_basis: paraphrase describes concern with air and noise pollution caused by the Airport Spur
summary: Alan Staeger, a private citizen residing at 5801 South 15th Place, expressed concern about the increase in air and noise pollution that would result from the Airport Spur. His comment was addressed by a reference to pages 141 and 150 of the Final EIS, which contain the noise and air quality response sections.
